format: RyzoBee user guide screenshot manifest v1
source_kind: Current same-source firmware UI host render, not a physical device capture
conversion: sips BMP to PNG only; no crop, scaling, retouching, or screenshot text replacement
visual_inspection: Each selected PNG was opened with view_image at native resolution. No blank/wrong pages or obsolete HOLD 3S labels retained.
pixel_verification: 21/21 images checked with Pillow: dimensions exactly 240x240 and decoded RGB byte arrays equal to their source BMPs.
data_policy: All shown times, filenames, counts, measurements, network values, QR credentials, pair codes, and pass states are DEMO fixtures. They are not device readings, available networks, production credentials, hardware verification, or a guarantee of iPhone discovery.
